text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I've got to talk to you about something."
It's been a while since
Palmer's confided in
me, and she looks tense. After a bit of
silence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
S-so hey! I was thinkin' that I really do
want to try running free... In my
own kinda
way, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like I did at those freestyle races... No,
actually, I wanna go beyond
that! I just
wanna blast off, right out of the gates!
Like... That's what's
most fun for me... I
think!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna give it a try, at least. That's the
only way I believe I can
compete. If I'm
running and having fun, then somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... So whaddya think, Trainer? Haha,
gonna say it's too risky, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, like, it's a pretty big gamble as far
as strategies go. I'll
probably get myself all
tuckered out before the finish and make a

major fool out of myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I get it... You can't be having a Mejiro
under your wing run like that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She begins to trail off. I feel her resolve,
however, and ask her
something in return.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, yeah. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer! Paaal-mer!
Paaal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Right. That's right! I wanna...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We gotta aim for front-running dominance!
Can you arrange my
regimen and
scrimmages for that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We turn a new page on our training
regimen from this moment
forward. We're
going to focus on developing her front
running skills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff... How's this for a start? Does this look okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...!
Like never before... Even more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(So I've gotta really run... Wait, maybe
that's not enough?! No, it's
not... I need to
do more... That's right!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Raisin' the roof, bringin' down the house,
all while having a blast!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta run like I wanna bring the place
down! Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Shoot, my breath... Oof! I can't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Phew... Huff... Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I reeeally brought the place down, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, the day of the scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-whahey! ☆ Get that W,
Palmster!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know it, fam! Lesgooo! I'm boutta slay
this race for real! Let's get
it!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
W-well she seems to be in good spirits.
Haha, I guess she's doing
okay. Didn't she
lose in a big way just the other day,
though?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, when she ran with Mejiro Ryan, I
think? I've got my eyes on
someone else
today, tho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, seems like everyone's
underestimating me again. Good, I'm

gettin' more fired up by the second!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You bet! Here goes nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, why don't we seek a better vantage
point? Something is
different about Palmer
today. I can feel it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Yeah, I think you're right. I was
about to suggest the same!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Runner A
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Sh-she's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Runner B
text_block_list.text: Uh, isn't that like way too fast?! They just started!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Run away, run away, run away! From
common sense, from the Mejiro
name!
From my own messed up way of thinking,
just gotta run run run!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (All I gotta do is have a blast! I can do this—I will be true to myself!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
You're... kidding. She actually won running
like that?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Practically no one runs like that!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: So this is... Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Amazing. Just amazing! Palmer's running is
unlike anyone's in the
entire Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In other words, a running style that she can
call her own. It seems that
none of us can
afford to underestimate it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Paaalmeeer! Yikes, what the HECK, girl?
That was like so freakin',
freakin'...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
LIT! You brought this place down, for sure!
Palmster, you absolutely
slayed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Thanks, Helios. You absolutely
slay too, my sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And thanks, Trainer, for giving me that
push I needed. And from here
on I just
gotta keep...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Raisin' the roof and stuff! Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pledge not to rest until the name "Mejiro
Palmer" is indeed one that
will never be
forgotten by time.
